title: Quantum Mechanics II
description: An advanced quantum mechanics course covering symmetry and formalism review, time-independent and degenerate perturbation theory, variational and WKB methods, time-dependent perturbation theory, Fermi's golden rule, radiation-matter interaction, identical particles, angular momentum addition, many-electron atoms, scattering, and the Dirac equation.

topics.title: Review of Quantum Formalism and Symmetry
topics.description: Builds conceptual fluency and applied skill with review of quantum formalism and symmetry.

children.title: Specific Terms and Concepts
children.description: Learn the named vocabulary that makes review of quantum formalism and symmetry precise rather than just intuitive.

children.title: Procedures, Calculations, or Analytic Moves
children.description: Practice the concrete moves students should be able to perform when working with review of quantum formalism and symmetry.

children.title: Set up a variational trial function
Apply perturbation Hamiltonian in a worked example
Compare selection rule with transition amplitude
Common Cases, Pitfalls, and Checks
children.description: Use these details to recognize where review of quantum formalism and symmetry succeeds, where it can mislead, and what to check before trusting a result.

Explain how perturbation Hamiltonian changes the interpretation
